path=progdir/'task-6cd32350.py'
source='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Find vertical guide columns in the lower part of the grid.
    horizontal_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(g) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3]
    last_horizontal = max(horizontal_rows) if horizontal_rows else -1
    guides = []
    for c in range(w):
        cells = [r for r in range(last_horizontal + 1, h) if g[r][c] != 0]
        if len(cells) >= 2 and cells == list(range(cells[0], cells[-1] + 1)):
            guides.append(c)
    for c in guides:
        crossings = []
        for r in horizontal_rows:
            if g[r][c] != 0:
                continue
            # A horizontal stripe crosses the guide when both neighboring sides contain color.
            left = [g[r][j] for j in range(c - 1, -1, -1) if g[r][j] != 0]
            right = [g[r][j] for j in range(c + 1, w) if g[r][j] != 0]
            if left and right:
                # The bordering stripe has the same color on both sides in these patterns.
                color = left[0] if left[0] == right[0] else (left[0] if len(left) <= len(right) else right[0])
                crossings.append((r, color))
        start = 0
        for r, color in crossings:
            for y in range(start, r + 1):
                if g[y][c] == 0:
                    g[y][c] = color
            start = r + 1
    return g
'''
